install:
npm ci && mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh" && chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh" && if [ -n "${DOKKU_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]; then printf '%s
' "$DOKKU_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$HOME/.ssh/dokku"; chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/dokku"; printf 'Host app.ic.ufba.br
  HostName 200.128.51.137
  Port 9999
  User dokku
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/dokku
  StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new
' > "$HOME/.ssh/config"; fi

terminals.name: db
terminals.command: docker compose up -d db && docker compose exec -T db pg_isready -U postgres || true
